title: Contracted slab runrate projection - Jun 2029
description: Working sheet: per-contract reserved slab inventory, regional mapping, and runrate projection used to inform Dedicated capacity planning and customer onboarding windows. Not final; contains rough notes and scenario rows for modelling ramp / churn.
assumptions: Slab = 8xH100-80GB equivalent vCPU/GPU unit for billing mapping
Average sustained concurrency per slab = 14 inference streams
Prefix/KV cache savings applied as 7% token reduction for chat workloads
Planned autoscale buffers: 10% headroom beyond committed runrate
Fallback variant uses A100-80GB for shortfalls (compatibility verified)
All times in customer timezone; conversions to UTC handled at rollout

runrate_summary: Total reserved slabs (sheet): 66 slabs across 6 contracts. Equivalent H100-80GB count (normalized): 66 slabs * 8 GPUs/slab = 528 GPUs. Current projected average utilization across contracts = 62% (weighted). Expected active slab runrate in next 6 months: 56 slabs (accounting for 10% buffer and two trial conversions). Risk buckets: near-term start-date slippage (AcornAI, HelixLabs) could reduce utilization by ~9% in Jul-Aug; conversely NorthsideRetail seasonal test could add 4 slabs temporarily in Oct.
